config.label: Base58 secret key, or path to a Solana CLI JSON keypair file
config.description: Base58 secret key, or path to a Solana CLI JSON keypair file. Unset = read-only mode: reads and dry runs work, nothing can be signed.

config.label: Largest single bid the server will sign, in SOL
config.description: Largest single bid the server will sign, in SOL. Required whenever BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is set; enforced in code before anything is signed.

config.label: Total gross bids allowed per rolling 24 hours, in SOL
config.description: Total gross bids allowed per rolling 24 hours, in SOL. Defaults to MAX_BID_SOL. Refunds do not restore the allowance.

config.label: false (default): write tools return a proposal and only approve_proposal signs
config.description: false (default): write tools return a proposal and only approve_proposal signs. true: write tools sign directly, still inside the limits.

config.label: Operator-written intent file, returned verbatim in every read_billboard response
config.description: Operator-written intent file, returned verbatim in every read_billboard response. A missing file is not an error.

config.label: Optional URL of a site-published history
config.description: Optional URL of a site-published history.json. Unset, unreachable or disagreeing with the chain = flip history derived on-chain.

config.label: Websocket endpoint for account-change subscriptions
config.description: Websocket endpoint for account-change subscriptions. Defaults to RPC_URL with https replaced by wss.

config.label: Append-only JSONL log of every proposal, approval, refusal and transaction, each with the agent's reasoning
config.description: Append-only JSONL log of every proposal, approval, refusal and transaction, each with the agent's reasoning.
